title: Not really what its advertising claims
text: This company says its toys are "designed" locally. Know that while this may be true, if you search for made in USA this product will come up, but four of the five  toys said they were actually "Made in China." So you can buy the same cheap toys at any discount store for about half the price. One toy only was domestically made, and it was of soft and high quality. I cancelled this subscription.
label: negative
